title_en: Jobs (19/20): A Courier on the Rounds
note_en: 像……一样 compares something to a model: 堆得像小山一样高 "piled up as high as a small hill." 像 introduces the thing you compare with, 一样 closes the frame, and an adjective after it (高) names the quality being compared, much like English "as high as." Here the whole comparison also follows 得, describing how the piling turned out.
